description: A comprehensive test script for Lua interpreter features, including environment variables, command-line options, error handling, warnings, file operations, and process control.

methods.name: prepfile
methods.description: Writes a string to a file, optionally in binary mode.

methods.name: getoutput
methods.description: Reads the content of the output file and deletes it.

methods.name: checkprogout
methods.description: Checks if the output matches expected lines.

methods.name: RUN
methods.description: Executes a command with Lua interpreter, replacing 'lua' with the program name.

methods.name: NoRun
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail with specific error message.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Replaces ';;' in path strings with default path.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Sends an interrupt signal to a process by pid.

methods.name: runback
methods.description: Runs a Lua script in background, returns process handle and pid.
